Cross-Border Acquisitions & India Market Entry

A foreign buyer considering an Indian acquisition should assess strategic fit, sector-specific investment restrictions, transaction structure, tax and financing with qualified advisers. Acquisition origination and regulatory diligence are separate but connected workstreams.

Start a private enquiry ↗

Choose an acquisition thesis for India

Decide whether the objective is local customers, manufacturing access, distribution, technical capabilities or a regional operating platform. Set the ownership and operating requirements before beginning target discovery.

Assess regulatory feasibility early

Foreign investment rules vary by sector, investor circumstances and structure. Qualified counsel should review applicable FEMA, FDI, competition, tax and approval requirements before binding commitments. Do not infer eligibility from a transaction in a different sector.

Manage information and execution across borders

Align the local operating team and overseas investment committee on evidence requirements, financing certainty, timetable and governance. Introduce owners only under agreed confidentiality arrangements. Allow sufficient time for diligence and regulatory review.

How Legacy Search can help

Legacy Search describes India as its core origination market and maintains cross-border relationship focus in the UAE and Singapore. We help buyers define an India acquisition brief and explore relevant owner conversations. This does not imply offices or regulatory authorisations in those markets.

Common questions

Can every foreign buyer acquire 100% of an Indian company?

No. The answer depends on the sector, investor and transaction structure; obtain transaction-specific legal advice.

Can I start before selecting an Indian target?

Yes. Defining a clear acquisition brief and regulatory screening criteria is a useful first step.

General information only; not legal, tax or investment advice. Transaction availability, suitability and execution depend on the circumstances.
